checkDescriptions.workitem-sections: workitem.md has non-empty Problem, Triage, Scope, Tasks sections; frontmatter parses; no TBD in Problem/Scope
checkDescriptions.triage-scorecard: Triage table has a yes/no answer on every row and the chosen lane is consistent with the lane rule (all no = quick, any yes = standard)
checkDescriptions.base-recorded: frontmatter `base:` is a resolvable git commit
checkDescriptions.protected-paths-lane: no path in Scope or in the measured diff matches config protectedPaths (quick lane only)
checkDescriptions.spec-artifact: frontmatter `spec:` points at an existing spec document; an Operator-template spec (inside the work item directory) must have every section filled, no TBD, and at least one numbered Acceptance criteria entry; an external spec tool's artifact (spec-kit, OpenSpec, hand-written) must exist and be non-empty — its structure is the external tool's contract
checkDescriptions.operator-approval: journal contains an `APPROVAL plan granted by operator:` line quoting the operator
checkDescriptions.tasks-complete: every checkbox in the Tasks section is checked
checkDescriptions.postmortem-if-thrashing: fewer than config postmortemThreshold `ATTEMPT` journal lines since the last `POSTMORTEM` (repeated failure forces a method postmortem)
checkDescriptions.tests-pass: config testCommand exits 0 (testCommand false = explicitly waived, journaled)
checkDescriptions.diff-within-lane-caps: measured diff since `base` is within config lane caps (files, changed lines)
checkDescriptions.diff-within-scope: every file in the measured diff matches the Scope section's declared paths (the spec artifact's own directory is excluded from the measurement)
checkDescriptions.self-review-evidence: journal contains a `REVIEW self` line with findings summary
checkDescriptions.review-evidence: journal contains a `REVIEW` line recording reviewer context, findings count, and resolution
checkDescriptions.security-review-if-protected: if the diff touches protectedPaths, journal contains a `REVIEW security` line
checkDescriptions.dod-complete: every checkbox in the Definition of done section is checked
checkDescriptions.docs-updated-or-waived: journal contains `DOCS updated:` or `DOCS no-impact:` with a reason
checkDescriptions.memory-harvest: journal contains a `MEMORY harvested:` or `MEMORY none:` line with a reason
checkDescriptions.memory-caps: no memory file exceeds its configured line cap
checkDescriptions.retro-filled: Retro section is non-empty and contains no TBD
